{"mode":"iff","restated":"∀ language : BitLanguage, IsNP language = true → ∃ map : List Bool → List Bool, Nonempty (BitTM map) ∧ (∀ input : List Bool, language input = true → ∃ record : BinarySyndromeDecodingInstance, encodeBinarySyndromeDecodingInstance record = map input ∧ 0 < record.blockLength ∧ 0 < record.radius ∧ ∃ word : Fin record.blockLength → ZMod 2, binarySyndromeProduct record word = binarySyndromeTarget record ∧ hammingNorm word ≤ record.radius) ∧ (∀ input : List Bool, ¬ (language input = true) → ∃ record : BinarySyndromeDecodingInstance, encodeBinarySyndromeDecodingInstance record = map input ∧ 0 < record.blockLength ∧ 0 < record.radius ∧ (∃ word : Fin record.blockLength → ZMod 2, binarySyndromeProduct record word = binarySyndromeTarget record) ∧ ∀ word : Fin record.blockLength → ZMod 2, binarySyndromeProduct record word = binarySyndromeTarget record → binaryCodeGapFactor record.blockLength * (record.radius : ℝ) < (hammingNorm word : ℝ))","proof":"unfold IsNPHardPromise
simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
constructor
· intro h language hl
  obtain ⟨R⟩ := h language hl
  refine ⟨R.map, R.polynomial_time, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro input hin
    have := R.completeness input hin
    simpa only [binarySyndromeDecodingPromise, decide_eq_true_eq] using this
  · intro input hin
    have := R.soundness input hin
    simpa only [binarySyndromeDecodingPromise, decide_eq_true_eq] using this
· intro h language hl
  obtain ⟨map, hp, hc, hs⟩ := h language hl
  exact ⟨{ map := map, polynomial_time := hp, completeness := fun input hin => by simpa only [binarySyndromeDecodingPromise, decide_eq_true_eq] using hc input hin, soundness := fun input hin => by simpa only [binarySyndromeDecodingPromise, decide_eq_true_eq] using hs input hin }⟩","english":"For every NP language L there is a polynomial-time computable map on bit strings such that: if x ∈ L, the image encodes a syndrome-decoding instance (positive block length and radius) having a word with the given syndrome and Hamming weight ≤ radius; if x ∉ L, the image encodes an instance with a solution to the syndrome equation, and every solution has weight greater than n^(1/200)·radius.","why_clearer":"It removes the Bool/decide encoding and the PromiseReduction/PromiseProblem wrappers, spelling out the Karp-style gap reduction with explicit YES/NO conditions."}

parsed.restated: ∀ language : BitLanguage, IsNP language = true → ∃ map : List Bool → List Bool, Nonempty (BitTM map) ∧ (∀ input : List Bool, language input = true → ∃ record : BinarySyndromeDecodingInstance, encodeBinarySyndromeDecodingInstance record = map input ∧ 0 < record.blockLength ∧ 0 < record.radius ∧ ∃ word : Fin record.blockLength → ZMod 2, binarySyndromeProduct record word = binarySyndromeTarget record ∧ hammingNorm word ≤ record.radius) ∧ (∀ input : List Bool, ¬ (language input = true) → ∃ record : BinarySyndromeDecodingInstance, encodeBinarySyndromeDecodingInstance record = map input ∧ 0 < record.blockLength ∧ 0 < record.radius ∧ (∃ word : Fin record.blockLength → ZMod 2, binarySyndromeProduct record word = binarySyndromeTarget record) ∧ ∀ word : Fin record.blockLength → ZMod 2, binarySyndromeProduct record word = binarySyndromeTarget record → binaryCodeGapFactor record.blockLength * (record.radius : ℝ) < (hammingNorm word : ℝ))
parsed.proof:
unfold IsNPHardPromise
simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
constructor
· intro h language hl
  obtain ⟨R⟩ := h language hl
  refine ⟨R.map, R.polynomial_time, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro input hin
    have := R.completeness input hin
    simpa only [binarySyndromeDecodingPromise, decide_eq_true_eq] using this
  · intro input hin
    have := R.soundness input hin
    simpa only [binarySyndromeDecodingPromise, decide_eq_true_eq] using this
· intro h language hl
  obtain ⟨map, hp, hc, hs⟩ := h language hl
  exact ⟨{ map := map, polynomial_time := hp, completeness := fun input hin => by simpa only [binarySyndromeDecodingPromise, decide_eq_true_eq] using hc input hin, soundness := fun input hin => by simpa only [binarySyndromeDecodingPromise, decide_eq_true_eq] using hs input hin }⟩
parsed.english: For every NP language L there is a polynomial-time computable map on bit strings such that: if x ∈ L, the image encodes a syndrome-decoding instance (positive block length and radius) having a word with the given syndrome and Hamming weight ≤ radius; if x ∉ L, the image encodes an instance with a solution to the syndrome equation, and every solution has weight greater than n^(1/200)·radius.
parsed.why_clearer: It removes the Bool/decide encoding and the PromiseReduction/PromiseProblem wrappers, spelling out the Karp-style gap reduction with explicit YES/NO conditions.
